parsed.change_summary: No changes were made to the code as the reported vulnerability (CWE-78: OS Command Injection) does not apply to the given code fragment. The code does not execute any OS commands based on user input.
parsed.how_trigger_is_blocked: The trigger described in the finding involves user input that could potentially lead to OS command injection. However, the code fragment provided does not execute any OS commands. It only reads and processes CSV files based on user input. Therefore, the trigger cannot be exploited in this context.
